title: Recursive strict expression models and their system comparisons
statement: Fix l,E,W and a completed-operation model M. For any family N of Good strict sequence-site complexes [stage3-pur-integral-realization-data], every finite completed-operation expression P [def-pur-completed-operation-comparison-data] has Good strict interpretation value(N,P). Recursively define systemComparison from Q(value(N,P)) to systemValue(M,P)(Q N) by identity at inputs and units, the specified K-flat tensor-model comparison followed by the two factor comparisons at tensors, and the inverse exact-localization factor followed by the factor comparison at pullbacks. If the inputs are normalized and M satisfies ComparisonLaws, all value(N,P) are normalized. These comparisons are fixed constructions, not arbitrary existence witnesses.

proof.text: Induct on the expression. Inputs are the hypotheses. For the unit, the degree-zero coefficient is flat and all other degrees are zero; M.system(a).unitKFlat supplies K-flatness. Tensor preserves Good by the K-flat total-tensor model.

proof.text: For inverse image, use the normalized tensorData of the sequence-site pullback. Its normalization asserts preservation of flat-term K-flat representatives. This applies on the whole sequence site, including non-cartesian coefficient transitions.
